description: Regex keys within the shared syntax and its limits are valid (Format 7.2, 14): every flag, categories, class escapes, a lazy quantifier, an escaped slash, a word boundary, groups nested 100 deep, and patterns of up to 1000 bytes written out in full. A key whose text after its last slash isn't lowercase letters, such as /r/ fans, is a plain key
note: Written out, (a{10}){83} is (aaaaaaaaaa) 83 times, 996 bytes, and a{998,} is 998 copies of a then a*, 1000 bytes. The slashes around a key aren't part of its pattern.

entries.text: a category, class escapes, a class with a literal -, a lazy quantifier, an escaped slash and a word boundary
a - first in a class, escaped brackets, other punctuation unescaped in a class, a character escape and a category; and a count of 1000, written out in exactly 1000 bytes
